steps.caption: Open Companies and a company that came from a spreadsheet: Pebblewick Software.
Under the name: 'Source (n spreadsheet rows)'. People and buildings have the same link.
One card per spreadsheet row behind this record: file name, version and the sheet!row.
Each field with its exact cell (for example Contacts!F2) and the value as it was in the file.
Open original downloads that version of the file; 'import report' opens the import.
Value history: imported values that disagreed with the record. Imports never overwrite a saved value.
Now a company with captured evidence: Marigold Loop Technologies.
'From capture' counts the extracted items linked to this company.
Open it: the note it came from, with the receipt, the original words and your corrections.
Each extracted item says its source: the note or file, page, when it was observed and how it was verified.
Capture history lists everything ever captured: Capture → Capture history.
Each entry: type, status, date, how many items were extracted, your corrections and linked records.
Click any entry to open the original note or file and its extracted items.
